templates.name: Coded term hierarchy summary
templates.intended_use: Number (%) of subjects (optionally also number of events) by dictionary-coded terms: System Organ Class / Preferred Term, ATC class / preferred name, AESI or SMQ category / Preferred Term, or Preferred Term only; data-driven term rows below an 'any' row; optional split by grade, severity or relationship.
templates.not_for: Predefined status or criterion rows such as AE overview flags, disposition or deviations (criterion-count template); subject-level listings of events.

presets.name: Medical history by SOC and PT
Prior / concomitant / subsequent medications by ATC class and preferred name
Treatment-emergent adverse events by SOC and PT
aliases: by system organ class and preferred term

templates.name: Continuous endpoint with between-group estimate
templates.intended_use: Descriptive statistics of a continuous endpoint and its baseline / post-baseline components, followed by a model-based or nonparametric between-group estimate (LS mean difference, Hodges-Lehmann shift) with confidence interval and optional p-value.
templates.not_for: Descriptive-only summaries (variable summary or parameter-by-visit templates); binary endpoints (response rate template).

presets.name: Change from baseline with model-based estimate

templates.name: Subject counts by criterion
templates.intended_use: Number (%) of subjects meeting each of a list of predefined criteria or status flags (disposition status and reasons, analysis-set membership, protocol-deviation categories, deaths and causes, AE overview categories, DLT, anti-drug antibody status, clinically notable thresholds). Rows may be nested and need not be mutually exclusive.
templates.not_for: Distribution of one variable over exhaustive categories (variable summary template); dictionary-coded terms (coded-term template); category counts repeated by visit (parameter-by-visit template).
aliases: overall summary of treatment-emergent adverse events
summary of treatment emergent adverse events overview

presets.name: Adverse event overview
aliases: overall summary of treatment-emergent adverse events
summary of treatment emergent adverse events

templates.name: Parameter by visit summary
templates.intended_use: For each parameter, a block per visit/timepoint: continuous descriptive statistics of observed value (and optionally change from baseline), or categorical n (%) of assessment categories (including threshold categories at baseline / worst post-baseline), by group.
templates.not_for: Statistics shown as columns (timepoint-statistics template); baseline x post-baseline cross-classification (shift template); single reference-point summaries (variable summary template).

presets.name: Tumor size and percent change by assessment

templates.name: Response / incidence rate endpoint
templates.intended_use: Binary or categorical endpoint: distribution of response categories, rate n (%) with confidence interval, and optionally a between-group estimate (difference, odds ratio) and test.
templates.not_for: Time-to-event endpoints (time-to-event template); continuous endpoints with model estimates (continuous comparison template); plain category distributions without CI (variable summary template).

presets.name: Best overall response and response rates

templates.name: Shift / cross-classification table
templates.intended_use: Cross-classification of subjects by two categorical assessments: baseline category or grade (rows) by post-baseline / worst post-baseline category (columns), or two raters/methods (concordance), within treatment-group row blocks and optionally per parameter and visit.
templates.not_for: Single categorical distributions by visit (parameter-by-visit template); counts of non-exclusive criteria (criterion-count template).

templates.name: Timepoint summary with statistics in columns
templates.intended_use: Rows are nominal timepoints within analyte/parameter blocks, columns are statistics (n, Mean (SD), Median, Min, Max, geometric mean, geometric CV%); groups appear as row blocks.
templates.not_for: Layouts with groups as columns (parameter-by-visit template); PK parameter summaries (variable summary template).

templates.name: Time-to-event endpoint summary
templates.intended_use: Number of events and censored subjects, Kaplan-Meier quartiles of the event time with confidence intervals, optional landmark event-free rates, and optionally a hazard ratio and test.
templates.not_for: Rates at a fixed time analysed as binary (response/incidence rate template); KM curves (Kaplan-Meier figure).

templates.name: Variable distribution summary
templates.intended_use: Summarise variables at a single reference point (e.g. baseline, overall treatment period): continuous variables as descriptive-statistic rows and categorical variables as exhaustive, mutually exclusive category rows with n (%), by treatment group.
templates.not_for: Summaries repeated by visit (parameter-by-visit template); rows that are non-exclusive criteria or status flags such as disposition, analysis sets, deviations or AE overview (criterion-count template); dictionary-coded terms such as SOC/PT or ATC (coded-term template); endpoints with confidence intervals or between-group estimates.

templates.name: Subject record listing
templates.intended_use: Any subject-level data listing: one row per subject, per subject and record, per subject and visit (wide) or per subject, parameter and visit (long), with configurable fields, stacked cells, group headers and column panels.
templates.not_for: Summary tables; catalogs that do not list subjects (e.g. protocol eligibility criteria text).

presets.name: Disease history and prior procedure records
Study drug administration and exposure records

templates.name: Box plot by group
templates.intended_use: Distribution of a continuous value (typically change or percent change from baseline at one time point) by group: box (quartiles), median line, whiskers, optional mean marker and individual points.

presets.name: Percent change from baseline by group

templates.name: Individual subject profiles
templates.intended_use: One line per subject plotted against visit or time (spider plot of percent change, individual values, individual concentration-time), with one panel per group and optional reference lines.
templates.not_for: Group summaries (summary-over-time figure); best change per subject as bars (waterfall figure).

presets.name: Spider plot of percent change from baseline

templates.name: Kaplan-Meier plot
templates.intended_use: Kaplan-Meier estimate of the probability of remaining event-free over time, one step curve per group, censor marks and an optional number-at-risk table below the x axis.
templates.not_for: Group means or percentages over visits (summary-over-time figure); cumulative incidence with competing risks; tables of KM estimates (time-to-event table).

templates.name: Group summary over time
templates.intended_use: A group-level summary statistic (mean with SD/SE error bars, median, or percentage of subjects in a category) plotted against visit or nominal time, one line per group; optional linear and semi-logarithmic panels.
templates.not_for: Individual subject trajectories (individual-profile figure); survival curves (Kaplan-Meier figure).

presets.name: Percentage of subjects per category over visits
Mean laboratory / clinical value over time

templates.name: Tornado (butterfly) plot
templates.intended_use: Mirrored horizontal bars of the percentage of subjects with each term for two groups (left and right), terms on the vertical axis.
templates.not_for: More than two groups; tables of term frequencies (coded-term template).

templates.name: Waterfall plot
templates.intended_use: Best percent change from baseline per subject as bars ordered from largest increase to largest decrease, optional fill by best overall response, reference lines at response thresholds, one panel per group.

presets.name: Best percent change in tumour size
